readout_other: MTS viability assay; Bradford total protein; Trypan Blue morphology; Fluo-3 AM calcium imaging with KCl challenge
direction_notes: Calcium responsiveness (AUC of F/F0 with KCl challenge) was higher 24 h after 10 V FUS than control; viability, protein and morphology were unchanged. Calcium imaging was done at 10 V only.
safety_notes: Viability (MTS), total protein and Trypan Blue morphology showed no significant damage at 5 V or 10 V.

exposures.label: FUS 5 V and 10 V drive, 10 min

device.model: custom immersion-type 300 kHz transducer driven by A-M Systems model 4100 isolated High-Power stimulator

timing.protocol_description: 30 train bursts of 0.5 s every 20 s (10 min total); each burst is a 300 kHz monophasic pulse train with pulse duration half of the event period (150,000 pulses per burst). Drive amplitude +5 V or +10 V; no acoustic calibration was performed.

source_quotes.n_subjects: using at least three independent primary neuronal preparations (n = 3)
